'''House of Marne''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. The most notable member is [[Arymilla Marne]].
[[File:Marne.png|thumb]]

==Sigil==
The sign of House Marne is four Silver Moons on a field of twilight blue.{{ref/book|10|p}}

==Activities==
*'''[[Succession Wars|Fourth Succession War]]''' - House Marne made a move for the [[Lion Throne]]. [[Arymilla]] assembled an army and attempted to overtake [[Elayne]] but in the end failed.{{ref/book|11|35}} House Marne was ruined.
